title: 信息日报 2026-07-28

headline.title: Moonshot AI 开源 2.8 万亿参数模型 Kimi K3，推动开源大模型边界
headline.summary: Moonshot AI 于 7 月 27 日开源了其 2.8 万亿参数模型 Kimi K3，权重文件达 1.56TB。该模型采用修改版 MIT 许可，要求超大规模使用进行署名。此举标志着开源大模型在规模和能力上的重大突破，广泛被视为对闭源模型的强有力挑战。
headline.title_en: Moonshot AI Open-Sources 2.8 Trillion Parameter Kimi K3, Pushing Open-Source LLM Boundaries
headline.summary_en: Moonshot AI open-sourced its 2.8 trillion parameter Kimi K3 model on July 27, with weights totaling 1.56TB under a modified MIT license requiring attribution for large-scale use. This move significantly pushes the boundary of open-source LLMs in scale and capability, widely seen as a strong challenge to proprietary models.
headline.reason: 该事件是今日最具影响力的技术新闻，Kimi K3 作为开源模型参数规模空前，直接冲击 AI 产业格局，引发开发者社区广泛关注与讨论。
headline.reason_en: This is the most impactful tech story of the day. Kimi K3's unprecedented scale as an open-source model directly challenges the AI industry landscape, generating widespread developer interest and discussion.
